material_blockers.summary: Private-file and configuration rejection paths retain raw authentication tokens and database passwords in production traceback-frame locals, violating the frozen confidentiality contract.
evidence: packet.md:59-65 requires credential/private-file failures to be sanitized and raw sensitive bytes to be unreachable through traceback frames or capture-locals formatting.

product/src/glupta_agi/settings.py:22-44 raises for invalid private-file length while `value` remains local; lines 69-74 reject a short intake capability while `token` remains local; lines 116-132 can reject database configuration after `password` is resolved and retained.

A read-only in-memory probe against exact product commit 8fb16e1433839f92600be4e8d310de1c4469c568 exercised all three real paths with synthetic values. The private-file value, complete short token, and database password were each reachable from their product traceback frames.
material_blockers.disposition: Keep dispatch and release frozen. Repair settings/private-file boundaries so sensitive values and secret-bearing objects are released before fresh sanitized exceptions are raised; add actual capture-locals regressions, freeze a new tuple/hash, and restart independent review.

non_blocking_findings: The supplied packet, manifest, and schema hashes matched exactly. All 70 manifest entries resolved at the specified commits with zero missing entries and zero hash mismatches.
The two R8-targeted changes—sanitized effect-conflict mapping and native package-metadata version identity—are present and consistent with their narrow R9 claims.
Open provider, account, release, deployment, and dispatch gates remain accurately preserved and effective; they are not themselves packet blockers.
factual_corrections: product/tests/test_settings.py:154-169 checks ordinary formatted traceback text, cause, and context, but does not establish the stronger traceback-frame or capture-locals confidentiality property required by the packet.

foundation_disposition.cost: Small bounded production repair plus regression tests and a complete new frozen-candidate review.
foundation_disposition.risk: High confidentiality impact if startup or configuration exceptions are recorded with locals; operational exposure remains prevented only while dispatch and release stay held.
foundation_disposition.rollback: R9 was not deployed, so no production rollback is needed. Preserve it as rejected history and supersede it only with a newly hashed candidate.

confidence_and_uncertainty: High confidence. The blocker follows directly from exact committed source and was deterministically reproduced without files, credentials, network access, or mutation. No peer-review result was sought or used; review stopped at the required production-defect hard gate.
